text:
lina (docs): quick flag — noticed a dead cross-ref in the Optimize toolkit examples page, the kv-prefetch section links to /opt/kv-cache which 404s :grimacing:
marco (eng): ugh, thanks for the catch. which example file?
lina (docs): the python batching example (example_batch_kv.md). link is in the "Usage" paragraph right after the snippet.
sanjay (ml): I can patch the md and open a tiny PR. do we want that link to point to /opt/cache-prefetch or to the new qprofiles page?
kat (product): product prefers pointing to cache-prefetch page for now — qprofiles will be a later follow-up. we should also add a short note about when to use prefetch vs kv caching.
marco (eng): ok i'll leave the exact target to you, sanjay. small nit: the code snippet uses old SDK args (use_cache=True) — needs to become `cache_policy="prefix"` for the new SDK. do that in the same PR if possible.
sanjay (ml): will do. patch plan: 1) update link to /opt/cache-prefetch, 2) replace `use_cache=True` with `cache_policy="prefix"`, 3) add 1-sentence note under example. open PR with "docs: fix cross-ref + sdk arg modernization"
marco (eng): thumbs up. also add a short test in examples CI to render the md so we catch future 404s. i can add that in a follow-up commit.
deploy-bot: new PR opened by sanjay: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/878 — title: docs: fix cross-ref + sdk arg modernization :rocket:
kat (product): nice. can you include a one-liner in the PR description explaining why cache_policy="prefix" is preferred for short, fanouty requests? helps reviewers.
sanjay (ml): good call, added. pinging @lina for doc review once CI passes. :pray:
lina (docs): will review today. thanks y'all!
marco (eng): small example snippet suggestion (if you want to include):
```python
# prefer explicit policy over boolean flag
client.generate(prompt, cache_policy="prefix", max_tokens=64)
```
marco (eng): minor but avoids confusion.
lina (docs): added that to the PR. CI shows one markdown lint warning (line length) — i'll tidy.
sanjay (ml): thanks — merging after doc LGTM and CI green.
kat (product): and add a changelog line under /opt/release-notes so PMs know we updated examples.
lina (docs): filed a follow-up PR for release notes once this merges. :white_check_mark:
